name: 49424 · Holland, MI
findings: ZIP 49424 (Holland) has 152 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49424 (Holland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
